{"reason": "All 20 failures are false arbitrations (rate 0.714); 6 of 8 example rows have confidence < 0.7, so a confidence gate filters them without touching exposure/pct logic, keeping recall near 1.0 for the 0.7+ positives.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (high-confidence? edi-change)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))))"}
